title: Sri Rama recollects the lotus-eyed Seetha
introduction: Rama recollects the lotus-eyed Seetha and laments much about his separation from her Lakshmana consoles him and there approaches the sun-set.
closing: Thus completes 5th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
सा तु नीलेन विधिवत् स्वारक्षा सुसमाहिता |
सागरस्य उत्तरे तीरे साधु सेना विनिएशिता
verses.iast:
sā tu nīlena vidhivat svārakṣā susamāhitā |
sāgarasya uttare tīre sādhu senā vinieśitā
verses.translation: That famous army, well-protected by Neela, was kept stationed nicely at the northern shore of the ocean.

verses.devanagari:
मैन्दः च द्विविधः च उभौ तत्र वानर पुम्गवौ |
विचेरतुः च ताम् सेनाम् रक्षा अर्थम् सर्वतो दिशम्
verses.iast:
maindaḥ ca dvividhaḥ ca ubhau tatra vānara pumgavau |
viceratuḥ ca tām senām rakṣā artham sarvato diśam
verses.translation: Both Maina and Dvivida the distinguished monkeys there moved in all directions through that army, for the purpose of vigilance.

verses.devanagari:
निविष्टायाम् तु सेनायाम् तीरे नद नदी पतेः |
पार्श्वस्थम् लक्ष्मणम् दृष्ट्वा रामो वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
niviṣṭāyām tu senāyām tīre nada nadī pateḥ |
pārśvastham lakṣmaṇam dṛṣṭvā rāmo vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: After the army was settled at the sea-shore, Rama spoke to Lakshmana who was by his side (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
शोकः च किल कालेन गच्चता हि अपगच्चति |
मम च अपश्यतः कान्ताम् अहनि अहनि वर्धते
verses.iast:
śokaḥ ca kila kālena gaccatā hi apagaccati |
mama ca apaśyataḥ kāntām ahani ahani vardhate
verses.translation: "It is so said that sorrow gets vanished at the passing of time. But my agony of not seeing my beloved is getting increased every day."

glosses.meaning: of not seeing kaantaam = my beloved

verses.devanagari:
न मे दुह्खम् प्रिया दूरे न मे दुह्खम् हृता इति च |
तद् एव अनुशोचामि वयो अस्या हि अतिवर्तते
verses.iast:
na me duhkham priyā dūre na me duhkham hṛtā iti ca |
tad eva anuśocāmi vayo asyā hi ativartate
verses.translation: "There is no anguish for me that my beloved is at a distance, nor that she was taken away. Her age is indeed passing away. Only about this, I am repenting."

verses.devanagari:
वाहि वात यतः कन्या ताम् स्पृष्ट्वा माम् अपि स्पृश |
त्वयि मे गात्र संस्पर्शः चन्द्रे दृष्टि समागमः
verses.iast:
vāhi vāta yataḥ kanyā tām spṛṣṭvā mām api spṛśa |
tvayi me gātra saṃsparśaḥ candre dṛṣṭi samāgamaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, wind! Flow from the side of my beloved. Touch her and touch me too. It is through you that I get a contact of her limbs. It is through moon that I get a contact of her eyes."

verses.devanagari:
तन् मे दहति गात्राणि विषम् पीतम् इव आशये |
हा नाथ इति प्रिया सा माम् ह्रियमाणा यद् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tan me dahati gātrāṇi viṣam pītam iva āśaye |
hā nātha iti priyā sā mām hriyamāṇā yad abravīt
verses.translation: "That darling being carried away; might have cried "Oh, Lord!" Seeking for help. That thought is like poison gulped by me, hovering in my stomach and scorching my limbs."

verses.devanagari:
तद् वियोग इन्धनवता तच् चिन्ता विपुल अर्चिषा |
रात्रिम् दिवम् शरीरम् मे दह्यते मदन अग्निना
verses.iast:
tad viyoga indhanavatā tac cintā vipula arciṣā |
rātrim divam śarīram me dahyate madana agninā
verses.translation: "My body is scorching night and day, by the fire of passion, holding fuel of my separation from her and my thoughts of her flaring into shimmering flames."

glosses.meaning: holding fuel of my separation from her
and my thoughts of her flaring up into shimmering flames.

verses.devanagari:
अवगाह्य अर्णवम् स्वप्स्ये सौमित्रे भवता विना |
कथंचित् प्रज्वलन् कामः समासुप्तम् जले दहेत्
verses.iast:
avagāhya arṇavam svapsye saumitre bhavatā vinā |
kathaṃcit prajvalan kāmaḥ samāsuptam jale dahet
verses.translation: "Oh, Lakshmana! Diving deep into the sea without you, I shall fall asleep. This flaming passion will not thus scorch me, lying down in water.

verses.devanagari:
बह्व् एतत् कामयानस्य शक्यम् एतेन जीवितुम् |
यद् अहम् सा च वाम ऊरुर् एकाम् धरणिम् आश्रितौ
verses.iast:
bahv etat kāmayānasya śakyam etena jīvitum |
yad aham sā ca vāma ūrur ekām dharaṇim āśritau
verses.translation: "It is enough for me, who is passionate, that Seetha with charming thighs and myself are resting on one the same earth and on this fact I am able to survive."

verses.devanagari:
केदारस्य इव केदारः स उदकस्य निरूदकः |
उपस्नेहेन जीवामि जीवन्तीम् यत् शृणोमि ताम्
verses.iast:
kedārasya iva kedāraḥ sa udakasya nirūdakaḥ |
upasnehena jīvāmi jīvantīm yat śṛṇomi tām
verses.translation: "Even as a paddy-field without water survives, by getting wet from a neighboring paddy-field under water, I also survive since I am hearing her as surviving.

verses.devanagari:
कदा तु खलु सुस्शोणीम् शत पत्र आयत ईक्षणाम् |
विजित्य शत्रून् द्रक्ष्यामि सीताम् स्फीताम् इव श्रियम्
verses.iast:
kadā tu khalu susśoṇīm śata patra āyata īkṣaṇām |
vijitya śatrūn drakṣyāmi sītām sphītām iva śriyam
verses.translation: "When shall I behold Seetha with charming hips, having long lotus-like eyes flourishing as prosperity, by conquering the enemies?"

verses.devanagari:
कदा नु चारु बिम्ब ओष्ठम् तस्याः पद्मम् इव आननम् |
ईषद् उन्नम्य पास्यामि रसायनम् इव आतुरः
verses.iast:
kadā nu cāru bimba oṣṭham tasyāḥ padmam iva ānanam |
īṣad unnamya pāsyāmi rasāyanam iva āturaḥ
verses.translation: "When, gently raising her face looking like louts, with its beautiful teeth and lips, shall I drink as a sick man the sovereign drink of remedy?"

glosses.meaning: with its beautiful teeth and lips
as a sovereign drink of remedy

verses.devanagari:
तौ तस्याः सम्हतौ पीनौ स्तनौ ताल फल उपमौ |
कदा नु खलु स उत्कम्पौ हसन्त्या माम् भजिष्यतः
verses.iast:
tau tasyāḥ samhatau pīnau stanau tāla phala upamau |
kadā nu khalu sa utkampau hasantyā mām bhajiṣyataḥ
verses.translation: "When will those breasts which are delightful close, bulging and quivering, looking like palmary fruits, indeed press me?"

verses.devanagari:
सा नूनम् असित अपान्गी रक्षो मध्य गता सती |
मन् नाथा नाथ हीना इव त्रातारम् न अधिगच्चति
verses.iast:
sā nūnam asita apāngī rakṣo madhya gatā satī |
man nāthā nātha hīnā iva trātāram na adhigaccati
verses.translation: "She, with dark-cornered eyes, who has fallen into the midst of demons, is surely not getting any defender, she resembling an orphan, though I am her support."

glosses.meaning: who has fallen in the middle of ogres

verses.devanagari:
कदा विक्षोभ्य रक्षांसि सा विधूय उत्पतिष्यति |
राक्षसीमध्यगा शेते स्नुषा दशरथस्य च
verses.iast:
kadā vikṣobhya rakṣāṃsi sā vidhūya utpatiṣyati |
rākśasīmadhyagā śete snuṣā daśarathasya ca
verses.translation: "How Seetha the daughter of King Janaka, my darling and Dasaratha's daughter-in-law is sleeping among ogresses?"

verses.devanagari:
अविक्षोभ्याणि रक्षांसि सा विधूयोत्पतिष्यति |
विधूय जलदान् नीलान् शशि लेखा शरत्स्व् इव
verses.iast:
avikśobhyāṇi rakśāṃsi sā vidhūyotpatiṣyati |
vidhūya jaladān nīlān śaśi lekhā śaratsv iva
verses.translation: "Seetha will come out, driving away (through my force) the unassailable demons, as driving away black clouds by a digit of the moon, in autumn."

glosses.meaning: driving away (through my force) avikshhobhyaaNi = the unassailable
by a digit of the moon

verses.devanagari:
स्वभाव तनुका नूनम् शोकेन अनशनेन च |
भूयस् तनुतरा सीता देश काल विपर्ययात्
verses.iast:
svabhāva tanukā nūnam śokena anaśanena ca |
bhūyas tanutarā sītā deśa kāla viparyayāt
verses.translation: "Seetha, who by nature is slender, will undoubtedly become leaner further because of her anguish, her abstinence from food and her adverse position of time and place."

glosses.meaning: and adverse position of time and place.

verses.devanagari:
कदा नु राक्षस इन्द्रस्य निधाय उरसि सायकान् |
सीताम् प्रत्याहरिष्यामि शोकम् उत्सृज्य मानसम्
verses.iast:
kadā nu rākṣasa indrasya nidhāya urasi sāyakān |
sītām pratyāhariṣyāmi śokam utsṛjya mānasam
verses.translation: "When shall I bring back Seetha, having lodged arrows in Ravana's chest and having abandoned this mental agony?"

verses.devanagari:
कदा नु खलु माम् साध्वी सीता अमर सुता उपमा |
स उत्कण्ठा कण्ठम् आलम्ब्य मोक्ष्यति आनन्दजम् जलम्
verses.iast:
kadā nu khalu mām sādhvī sītā amara sutā upamā |
sa utkaṇṭhā kaṇṭham ālambya mokṣyati ānandajam jalam
verses.translation: "When indeed Seetha the virtuous lady similar to the child of a celestial, with an excited longing, will embrace my neck and release tears of joy?"

glosses.meaning: similar to the child of a celestial

verses.devanagari:
कदा शोकम् इमम् घोरम् मैथिली विप्रयोगजम् |
सहसा विप्रमोक्ष्यामि वासः शुक्ल इतरम् यथा
verses.iast:
kadā śokam imam ghoram maithilī viprayogajam |
sahasā vipramokṣyāmi vāsaḥ śukla itaram yathā
verses.translation: "When shall I thrillingly abandon this terrible anguish, born out of my separation from Seetha so soon, as we abandon a soiled clothing?"

glosses.meaning: born out of my separation from

verses.devanagari:
एवम् विलपतस् तस्य तत्र रामस्य धीमतः |
दिन क्षयान् मन्द वपुर् भास्करो अस्तम् उपागमत्
verses.iast:
evam vilapatas tasya tatra rāmasya dhīmataḥ |
dina kṣayān manda vapur bhāskaro astam upāgamat
verses.translation: While that sagacious Rama was lamenting thus there, the sun, the weak-rayed due to day-decline, approached the dusk.

verses.devanagari:
आश्वासितो लक्ष्मणेन रामः संध्याम् उपासत |
स्मरन् कमल पत्र अक्षीम् सीताम् शोक आकुली कृतः
verses.iast:
āśvāsito lakṣmaṇena rāmaḥ saṃdhyām upāsata |
smaran kamala patra akṣīm sītām śoka ākulī kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Lakshmana consoled Rama who was overwhelmed with anguish, duly recollecting the lotus-eyed Seetha. Thereafter, Rama worshipped the evening-twilight.
